system.description:
Eat magic items for fun and profit! But beware of cursed items, as they could have negative effects. Make an Unopposed Skill Check.

On Success, you eat the item. It is destroyed, as the shitter will be tomorrow morning.

On an Amazing Success or better, gain 1 permanent Intelligence.

Note: the permanent Stat gains on Success/Crit are one-time narrative rewards the GM applies manually - this system's modifier engine only handles persistent, always-on bonuses, not per-roll-outcome triggers.

upgrades.description: On a Critical Hit, gain 1 additional permanent Intelligence.
On a Standard Success or better, gain 1 permanent Intelligence. You may eat cursed items with no ill effects.
You choose which Stat is permanently increased.
